prompt: Given an array of up to 1,000,000 integers and an integer k, write an efficient Python program to find the length of the longest contiguous subarray whose sum is exactly k. Your solution should run in O(n) time, include the complete Python implementation, explain the algorithm, and analyze its time and space complexity.

Implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache in Python supporting get(key) and put(key, value) operations in O(1) time. Do not use functools.lru_cache. Provide the complete implementation, explain your design using a hash map and doubly linked list, and analyze the complexity.

Given a directed weighted graph with up to 100,000 vertices and 300,000 edges, where edge weights may be negative but no negative cycles exist, implement an algorithm to compute the shortest path from a source node to every other node. If a negative cycle is detected, return 'NEGATIVE CYCLE'. Include complete Python code and complexity analysis.

Design a thread-safe in-memory key-value store in Python supporting put, get, delete, TTL expiration, and automatic cleanup of expired keys. Use Python threading primitives where appropriate. Provide complete code, explain your synchronization strategy, and analyze complexity.

Implement a Trie (Prefix Tree) in Python supporting insert(word), search(word), startsWith(prefix), and delete(word). Include complete code, explain the delete operation carefully, and analyze time and space complexity.

Given a binary tree, implement a Python function that returns the Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) of two nodes without storing parent pointers. Include complete code, explain the recursive approach, and analyze the algorithm's complexity.

Implement a Python program that solves the N-Queens problem for any integer N ≥ 4 using backtracking. Return all valid board configurations, explain the pruning strategy, and analyze the worst-case time complexity.

Given an unsorted list of intervals, merge all overlapping intervals and return the merged result. Implement the solution in Python, explain why sorting is required, and analyze the time and space complexity.

Implement a Python class for a weighted directed graph supporting edge insertion, deletion, BFS, DFS, Dijkstra's shortest path, and topological sort when applicable. Include complete code and explain the complexity of each operation.

Design and implement an in-memory distributed key-value store in Python that supports consistent hashing, configurable replication, optimistic concurrency control using version numbers, TTL expiration, snapshot persistence, and recovery. The implementation should be modular, thread-safe, and extensible. Include complete Python code, unit tests, architecture explanation, and detailed complexity analysis.
